claims.claim_text: The indexed Clarence R. Brown is confirmed as the Army entrant represented by the exact-name and private-identifier match in the official merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The full name and private service identifier match across the OSS index and official Army-entry file; the identifier is withheld.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by an exact private identifier and exact full indexed name.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army-entry record is dated July 28, 1943; the index documents an OSS personnel file but not the OSS transfer date.
claims.match_notes: Common-name military, obituary, genealogy, and modern results were rejected because they lacked the private identifier or Box 84 linkage.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry, Clarence R. Brown was recorded in the grouped category for occupations in the manufacture of radios and phonographs.
claims.evidence_excerpt: 4, 6, 8-99. Occupations in manufacture of radios and phonographs
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official record carries code 499; the official numerical list maps 4-99 to a broad radio-and-phonograph manufacturing group.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private identifier and full indexed name.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded to Army entry on July 28, 1943; its relation to OSS recruitment remains unknown.
claims.match_notes: No employer, plant, product, exact job, or immediate OSS predecessor is inferred from the grouped code.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index prints a second adjacent Charles J. Brown row with no identifier, Box 83, and the note '83?'. The preceding row has the same indexed name but a private identifier and Box 84. They remain separate people in a possible-duplicate group until both files are compared.
person_updates.next_action: Compare both adjacent Charles J. Brown files in Boxes 83-84 and determine whether the second row is a duplicate, cross-reference, or different person before assigning any employer or affiliation.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index supplies Charles E. Brown III and Box 83 but no private identifier, rank, occupation, or other discriminator. Exact-name OSS, official, institutional, employment, newspaper, obituary, directory, and archival searches did not establish the indexed identity.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 83 for birth, residence, occupation, and employer evidence; do not assign modern or unrelated same-name biographies.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index and official Army merged file agree on Clarence R. Brown's exact normalized name and private identifier. The identifier remains withheld; the Army row dates entry to July 28, 1943 and carries civilian occupation code 499.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 84 for the exact manufacturing job, employer, and Army-to-OSS chronology.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index and official Army merged file agree on Clarence S. Brown's exact normalized name and private identifier. The identifier remains withheld; the Army row dates entry to January 5, 1944 and carries civilian occupation code 555.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 84 for the theater or employer and Army-to-OSS chronology.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index supplies Clarence D. Brown Jr., a seven-digit private identifier, and Box 84. No official Army row begins with that identifier; a different-name row merely ends with the same digits after an additional prefix, so it is rejected rather than treated as a match.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 84 and the original personnel identifier before assigning Army status, an occupation, or any same-name veteran biography.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index supplies Daniel F. Brown and Box 84 but no private identifier, rank, occupation, or other discriminator. Exact-name Army candidates and web results could not be tied to the indexed person.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 84 for identifiers, residence, occupation, employer, and service chronology before choosing among common-name candidates.

research_attempts.query_text: Second indexed Charles J. Brown row: visually checked adjacent NARA rows and Boxes 83-84; Army, CIA, OSS, employment, occupation, institutional, newspaper, obituary, directory, and archival searches; possible-duplicate comparison.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Common-name candidates lacked a private identifier or direct Box 83 linkage; the adjacent indexed row cannot be merged without both personnel files.
research_attempts.research_notes: The two adjacent exact-name rows are grouped for duplicate review but remain separate entities.
research_attempts.next_action: Compare both Charles J. Brown personnel files in Boxes 83-84.
